name: OrderFollowUpRecall
title: Schedule Follow-Up Recall for Cervical Screening
description: Activity template for scheduling a follow-up recall task for cervical cancer screening — the operational artifact behind both post-treatment retest scheduling, post-triage-negative retest scheduling, and routine interval recalls. Instantiated by the CervicalCancerFollowUp PlanDefinition. Distinct from clinical orders (HPV/VIA/Treatment) in that this is a clerical scheduling task carried forward by the outreach team rather than a service request executed by a provider.
purpose: Provide a canonical template for the act of scheduling a follow-up recall task, suitable for the proposal phase of the FHIR CPG Activity Flow. The follow-up interval (e.g., 12 months post-triage-negative, 6 months post-treatment, or 3-5 years for routine recall) is set by the calling PlanDefinition action via dynamicValue on Task.restriction.period.

relatedArtifact.label: WHO Recommendations 14 / 34 (and Algorithm 5 follow-up cadence)
relatedArtifact.display: WHO Rec 14 (general) / Rec 34 (WLHIV): Re-screen at recommended intervals; post-treatment and post-triage-negative cadences specified in Algorithm 5 follow-up arms
